name: file-tree
description: Docked, collapsible file tree of the repo (respects .gitignore) that highlights files edited this turn. Toggle with /tree; /tree changed (or the pane's filter button) shows only changed files.

icons.title: File icons
icons.description: Nerd Font icons in the tree (needs a Nerd Font in your terminal); 'none' turns them off.

ignored.title: Ignored files
ignored.description: How .gitignored files show in the tree: 'dim' lists them greyed out (ignored folders as one row), 'hide' leaves them out. .DS_Store is always hidden.
